summary: This joint resolution, enacted as Public Law 119-8 on May 9, 2025, exercises congressional authority under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code (the Congressional Review Act), to disapprove a final rule of the Department of Energy. The rule disapproved is titled “Energy Conservation Program for Appliance Standards: Certification Requirements, Labeling Requirements, and Enforcement Provisions for Certain Consumer Products and Commercial Equipment,” published at 89 Fed. Reg. 81994 (October 9, 2024). The operative clause provides: “That Congress disapproves the rule … and such rule shall have no force or effect.” The resolution contains no additional provisions, amendments to existing law, exceptions, conditions precedent, appropriations, authorizations, or sunset clauses. It does not prescribe any deadlines or impose new regulatory requirements. The legal effect, as stated in the resolution, is that the identified rule is void and of no legal effect.
